description: Tests whether the decay channel's pairing is the Frobenius counit rather than the Ocneanu Markov trace. Refuted in the strong form: z = 1 fits the measured Q_beta scalar to 0.168 % but is PROVED non-admissible, while both admissible roots miss by >10 %. The required (1^3) weight is negative. Also cross-checks this arc's independently derived weight numerator against the committed Lean wtNumer -- symbolic difference exactly 0.

data.verdict: REFUTED IN THE STRONG FORM, and the refutation is the sharper result. z = 1 -- where the Ocneanu trace degenerates to the Frobenius counit -- reproduces the measured Q_beta scalar to 0.168 %, against 12.470 % for the augmentation (z = q) and 43.157 % for the Markov trace at z_D. But z = 1 is PROVED not an admissible Markov parameter (one_not_root, unconditional on the substrate window), and the admissible set is EXACTLY those two. So neither available point fits and the point that fits is forbidden. At z_required the (1^3) weight is NEGATIVE (-0.014131), so no positive-weight trace in this family reaches it. SCOPE-(a): measured non-admissibility and a measured negative weight; NOT a proved structural exclusion, which would need a positivity invariant on the decay pairing that the corpus does not carry.
